decisions.statement: A name the environment does not know answers with a stub.
A stub answers to being called.
A stub answers to being joined onto text as the empty string.
A stub answers to arithmetic as zero.
A stub reached for a field answers with another stub.
A name the caller bans answers with nothing.
A banned name is taken off the real globals as well.
A game function known to answer text answers with the empty string.
A game function known to answer a count answers with zero.
A game constant the loaded Lua branches on has the value the game gives that constant.
Loaded Lua runs with this environment in place of the real globals.
A value seeded by the caller is read before any stub is made.

definition: an environment that answers to every name the game's own Lua would reach for
